title: Двойное сравнение и усиление: the more… the more, ever-increasing, far / much / by far

why: Эти конструкции показывают, как одно изменение тянет за собой другое («чем больше... тем больше»), и позволяют точно регулировать силу сравнения: «намного», «чуть-чуть», «безусловно самый». Так звучит живая и точная речь на уровне C2.
formation: • The + сравнительная степень..., the + сравнительная степень...: The more you practice, the better you get.
• comparative and comparative: more and more popular, colder and colder
• усилители перед сравнительной степенью: far / much / a lot / a great deal / considerably / even / still + more expensive; ослабители: slightly / a bit / a little
• by far + превосходная степень: by far the best
• twice / three times / half as + прилагательное + as
usage: 1. Параллельное изменение: The longer the meeting lasted, the more bored people became. (Чем дольше длилась встреча, тем скучнее становилось людям.) Краткий вариант: The sooner, the better. (Чем раньше, тем лучше.)
2. Постоянное нарастание: It's getting harder and harder. (Становится всё труднее.) An ever-increasing number of users prefer dark mode. (Всё растущее число пользователей предпочитает тёмную тему.)
3. Усиление сравнения: This is far more difficult than I expected. (Это намного сложнее, чем я ожидал.)
4. Усиление превосходной степени: She is by far the best designer in our team. (Она, безусловно, лучший дизайнер в нашей команде.)
5. Кратность: This laptop is twice as expensive as that one. (Этот ноутбук вдвое дороже того.)
signalWords: far, much, a lot, a great deal, considerably, slightly, a bit, even, still, by far, twice as, ever-.
mistakes: ✗ More you practice, more you learn. → ✓ The more you practice, the more you learn. (артикль the обязателен в обеих частях)
✗ She is very more experienced. → ✓ She is far / much more experienced. (very не сочетается со сравнительной степенью)
✗ He is by far taller than me. → ✓ He is much taller than me. (by far работает только с превосходной: by far the tallest)
✗ the more harder you work → ✓ the harder you work (more и -er вместе не ставим)
✗ It is more and more cold. → ✓ It is colder and colder. (короткие прилагательные: -er and -er)
remember: The more..., the more...; very не усиливает сравнение, а by far усиливает только превосходную степень.

items.prompt: The more you practice, the ___ (good) you become.
items.answer: better

items.prompt: The ___ (early) we start, the sooner we finish.
items.answer: earlier

items.prompt: This is ___ ___ the most useful tool we have.
items.answer: by far

items.prompt: The app is getting more ___ more popular every month.
items.answer: and

items.prompt: The longer the meeting lasted, the more ___ (bored) people became.
items.answer: bored

items.prompt: The less you worry, the ___ (easy) it gets.
items.answer: easier

items.prompt: An ___-increasing number of users prefer dark mode.
items.answer: ever

items.prompt: This laptop costs $2000 and that one $1000: this one is ___ as expensive as that one.
items.answer: twice

items.prompt: She is ___ more experienced than me. (a) very (b) far
items.answer: (b) far

items.prompt: It's ___ the best hotel in town. (a) much (b) by far
items.answer: (b) by far

items.prompt: The ___ you reply, the better. (a) sooner (b) soon
items.answer: (a) sooner

items.prompt: The situation is ___ better than last week. (a) slightly (b) by far
items.answer: (a) slightly

items.prompt: He's ___ taller than his brother. (a) by far (b) much
items.answer: (b) much

items.prompt: The more expensive the hotel, ___ it is. (a) the more comfortable (b) more comfortable
items.answer: (a) the more comfortable

items.prompt: The test was ___ than I thought. (a) a great deal easier (b) a great deal more easy
items.answer: (a) a great deal easier

items.prompt: We have ___ demand for this product. (a) ever-increasing (b) ever-increase
items.answer: (a) ever-increasing

exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя слово в скобках

items.prompt: If you study more, you learn more. (The more...)
items.answer: The more you study, the more you learn.

items.prompt: As the code gets longer, it gets harder to read. (The longer...)
items.answer: The longer the code gets, the harder it is to read. / The longer the code gets, the harder it gets to read.

items.prompt: No other course is as good as this one. (by far)
items.answer: This is by far the best course.

items.prompt: The number of bugs keeps growing all the time. (ever-growing)
items.answer: There is an ever-growing number of bugs. / The number of bugs is ever-growing.

items.prompt: My flat is 50 square meters. Yours is 100. (twice as)
items.answer: Your flat is twice as big as mine.

items.prompt: The plane was a bit cheaper than the train. (slightly)
items.answer: The plane was slightly cheaper than the train.

items.prompt: Jon is much more careful than Tim. (Use far)
items.answer: Jon is far more careful than Tim.

items.prompt: As it gets darker, it gets colder. (The...the...)
items.answer: The darker it gets, the colder it gets.

items.prompt: More you practice, more you learn.
items.answer: The more you practice, the more you learn.

items.prompt: She is very more experienced than me.
items.answer: She is far more experienced than me. / She is much more experienced than me.

items.prompt: This is the most best option.
items.answer: This is the best option.

items.prompt: The sooner is the better.
items.answer: The sooner, the better.

items.prompt: He is by far taller than his brother.
items.answer: He is much taller than his brother. / He is far taller than his brother.

items.prompt: It is more and more cold every day.
items.answer: It is colder and colder every day.

items.prompt: The more harder you work, the more you earn.
items.answer: The harder you work, the more you earn.

items.prompt: Prices are ever-increase.
items.answer: Prices are ever-increasing.

items.prompt: Чем больше я работаю, тем больше устаю.
items.answer: The more I work, the more tired I get. / The more I work, the more tired I become.

items.prompt: Чем раньше вы начнёте, тем лучше.
items.answer: The sooner you start, the better.

items.prompt: Это намного сложнее, чем я думал.
items.answer: It is much harder than I thought. / It is far more difficult than I thought.

items.prompt: Это, безусловно, лучший фреймворк.
items.answer: This is by far the best framework.

items.prompt: Всё больше людей работают удалённо.
items.answer: More and more people work remotely.

items.prompt: Этот ноутбук вдвое дороже того.
items.answer: This laptop is twice as expensive as that one.

items.prompt: Всё растущее число пользователей жалуется на медленную загрузку.
items.answer: An ever-increasing number of users complain about slow loading.

items.prompt: Чем сложнее задача, тем интереснее её решать.
items.answer: The harder the task, the more interesting it is to solve.
